name: Prisma
tagline: Postgres databases, backups and Compute apps
description: Prisma lets agents list and create Prisma Postgres databases, read schemas, run SQL, list backups and restore them to a new database, manage Object Storage buckets, read Compute builds and logs, and search the Prisma docs. Each user signs in to their own Prisma account through the browser and selects a workspace. Agents get full access: they can run SQL that changes or deletes data, update schemas, delete databases and buckets, and stop, roll back or delete Compute deployments.

prompts.text: Which databases are in my Prisma workspace?
Show me all available backups of my database.
Show the runtime logs of my latest Compute deployment.

apps.name: Prisma
apps.description: Databases, SQL, backups, and Compute apps, over Prisma's MCP server with browser sign-in.
